description: Check an EU VAT number live against the European Commission's VIES system: valid or not, and the registered company name and address where the member state shares them. Northern Ireland (XI) numbers included. Sole traders' names are withheld (personal data). Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

number.description: VAT number with its country prefix, e.g. DE811569869.

name: eu-vat

name.description: Registered name if the country shares it and it is a company.

withheld.description: True when a name was hidden because it may belong to a sole trader.

title: EU VAT ($0.005)
